identity.title: Containment Spray and Cooling Systems, and a condition which could have prevented fulfillment of the safety function of the Containment Spray System

cause.proximate_text: The cause of the event was the failure of Operations Technicians to appropriately use human performance event prevention tools prior to operating equipment. Specifically, in restoring the B CS Train from the fill-and-vent operation on May 11, 2022, ENV0127 was left in a locked-open position instead of the appropriate locked-closed position.
cause.theme: valve mispositioning / human performance error during restoration

nodes.display_name: ENV0127, Containment Spray Pump B Recirculation Throttle Valve
ENV0127 left locked-open instead of locked-closed during restoration
nodes.description: During fill-and-vent restoration on May 11, 2022, restoration steps directed ENV0127 be locked-closed; technicians mistakenly left it locked-open.

nodes.display_name: Continuous recirculation path through open throttle valve degrades pump discharge pressure
nodes.description: With ENV0127 locked open, recirculation flow reduced B CS Pump discharge pressure below TS minimum of 250 psig, measured at 225 psig during surveillance test.

nodes.display_name: B Train Containment Spray System inoperable / TS LCO 3.6.6 not met
Both CS trains concurrently inoperable; condition could have prevented safety function fulfillment
Provide training to Operations on SSC positioning requirements, expectations, and tools

nodes.title: Mispositioning of manual containment isolation valve KAV0118, Service Air Containment Supply Outer Isolation Valve, due to inadequate procedural control

chain: human performance error (failure to use event-prevention tools) [cause TBD] -> ENV0127 left locked-open during May 11 fill-and-vent restoration -> continuous recirculation degrades B CS Pump discharge pressure below TS minimum -> B Train CS inoperable (TS LCO 3.6.6 not met, ~29 days) -> both A and B trains concurrently inoperable June 1 0346-0601 (could have prevented safety function fulfillment) [A Train otherwise operable throughout]
